name: 650 mm carbon X-frame kit
summary: A 650 mm wheelbase quad frame with folding tube arms, for 15-inch propellers. Sample data: the supplier and every figure here are fictional.

evidence.summary: Supplier drawings and carbon plate datasheet received.
checked: Plate thickness and layup as stated on the plate datasheet
Supplier statement that cutting and assembly are in Pune

documents.title: X650 frame drawing set, revision B

measurements.label: Wheelbase
measurements.method: Diagonal motor centre to motor centre, steel rule

parts.name: Centre plates
parts.role: Top and bottom plates that form the body and carry the electronics.
parts.whatItDoes: Two carbon plates held apart by standoffs. The arms clamp between them and the flight controller, ESCs and battery mount to them.
parts.whyItMatters: Plate thickness and layup set how much the body flexes, which feeds straight into vibration at the flight controller.
buyingChecks: Edges are sealed or chamfered so they do not cut wiring
Ask for the layup, not only the thickness
Check mounting holes for your flight controller pattern

parts.name: Folding arm joints
parts.role: Clamp each arm to the centre and let it fold for transport.
parts.whatItDoes: Machined aluminium clamps between the plates. A locking sleeve holds the arm straight in flight and releases it to fold.
parts.whyItMatters: Play in a folding joint becomes vibration at the motor. Joints are the first place a frame loosens with use.
buyingChecks: Ask for the alloy and whether the joint is anodised
Check for play with the arm locked, by hand
Ask how many fold cycles the joint is rated for

parts.name: Folding arms
parts.role: Carry the motors out to the wheelbase.
parts.whatItDoes: Four carbon tubes with folding joints at the body. They hold the motors and carry thrust back into the frame.
parts.whyItMatters: Arm stiffness is the biggest single factor in frame vibration. Folding joints add convenience but are a common source of play.
buyingChecks: Lock each folding joint and rock the arm; there should be no play
Ask for spare arms with each order
Check that motor mounts match your motor pattern

parts.name: Motor mounts
parts.role: Hold each motor at the arm tip.
parts.whatItDoes: Tube clamps with a flat plate drilled for the motor bolt pattern.
parts.whyItMatters: A mount that is not square to the arm tilts the thrust, and the flight controller works harder to correct it.
buyingChecks: Check the bolt pattern matches your motor
Ask whether the mount is keyed to stop it rotating on the tube
Ask for the mass of each mount

parts.name: Landing gear
parts.role: Carry the aircraft on the ground and protect the payload.
parts.whatItDoes: Two carbon skids on vertical legs that clamp under the bottom plate.
parts.whyItMatters: Hard landings load the gear first. A gear that cracks the bottom plate turns a minor landing into a frame replacement.
parts.material: Carbon-fibre tube with nylon or aluminium clamps
buyingChecks: Ask for the gear height and the payload clearance it gives
Check the clamps are made to break before the plate
Ask whether the gear can be removed without tools

demand.reason: Defence and government buyers reject drones with Chinese parts, and the frame is the largest single part. Drone tenders on the government marketplace rose to 355 in 2026 from 190 in 2025.

sources.title: Army drone procurement and the ban on Chinese parts, Rediff and Business Standard, 23 Nov 2026
